result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visible defects: a nonsensical '–0%' discount badge, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis, and a filter chip clipped at the screen edge with no visible label.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a '–0%' discount badge, which is meaningless — a 0% discount should not be displayed at all.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0, or fix the data feeding the badge so it shows the actual discount percentage.

issues.description: In 'Fastest near you', the third restaurant name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' — the text is clipped at the screen edge without an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Picco…') or constrain the label width to the visible card area within the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: The rightmost category filter chip (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the screen edge showing only an empty pill sliver with no readable label, giving no hint of its content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll peek so a meaningful portion of the next chip's label is visible, indicating that more categories can be scrolled to.

issues.description: The third card image and delivery fee ('€1.90 delivery') in 'Fastest near you' are partially cut off, and unlike the other cards its full name and delivery time badge extend beyond the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards snap or peek consistently so partially visible cards clearly read as scrollable content rather than a rendering glitch.
